overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（5 篇）、风险管理与衍生品（2 篇）、资产定价（2 篇）。方法上以机器学习、回归分析为主。来源分布：OpenAlex（5 篇）、arXiv（5 篇）、Semantic Scholar（2 篇）。其中 2 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title: Development of Augmented Reality Learning Media Using a Deep Learning Pedagogical Approach to Improve Early Childhood Scientific Literacy
papers.venue: Journal of General Education and Humanities
papers.abstract: Scientific literacy is a fundamental competency that should be developed from early childhood, yet many early childhood education institutions continue to rely on conventional instructional media that offer limited opportunities for interactive, meaningful science learning. Although Augmented Reality (AR) has demonstrated potential for enhancing learning engagement, few studies have integrated AR with a deep learning approach to foster early childhood scientific literacy through meaningful, mindful, and joyful learning experiences. Therefore, this study aimed to develop and evaluate Augmented Reality learning media based on a deep learning approach to improve children's scientific literacy at RA Al Qur’an Dina. This Research and Development (R&D) study employed the ADDIE model, consisting of analysis, design, development, implementation, and evaluation stages. Data were collected through interviews, observations, expert validation questionnaires, response questionnaires, and pretest–posttest instruments involving early childhood learners. The findings indicated that the developed media were valid and feasible, as assessed by media, material, and instrument experts. The results of the Focus Group Discussion (FGD), small group trials, and Training of Trainers (TOT) also confirmed that the media were practical, engaging, and easy to implement. Furthermore, large-group testing demonstrated a substantial improvement in children's scientific literacy, reflected in an N-Gain score of 0.98 (high category) and an effectiveness level of 97.93% (highly effective category). In conclusion, the developed Augmented Reality learning media effectively enhanced early childhood scientific literacy through interactive and meaningful learning experiences.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：如何利用深度学习教学法开发增强现实（AR）学习媒体，以改善幼儿的科学素养？

🔬 研究方法：采用研究与发展（R&D）模式，运用ADDIE模型（分析、设计、开发、实施、评估）进行开发与评估，并通过访谈、观察、专家验证及前测-后测收集数据。

📊 核心发现：开发的AR媒体经专家验证为有效且可行，大规模测试显示幼儿科学素养显著提升，N-Gain得分为0.98（高），有效性达97.93%。

💡 应用价值：该AR学习媒体通过提供互动且有意义的学习体验，有效促进了幼儿科学素养的发展。

papers.title: Consolidating Wealth and Power
papers.abstract: This study examines how the Basalamah family business was strengthened using political and social strategies. A qualitative method and case study approach was used for data collection, involving observation, in-depth interviews and documentation. Unlike previous business and political studies, this paper considers social capital as well as economic capital. This study complements political economy literature by demonstrating the influence of economic, political and religious identity forces on business and politics at the local level. The political strategy employed involved building a patronage network with local political elites, such as the Regent of Banyumas under the leadership of Joko Sudantoko, Aris Setiono and Mardjoko, and entering the world of practical politics by holding strategic positions in the Banyumas Regency Regional House of Representatives (Regency Council). Both strategies are important because informal connectivity is needed to build relationships with local political elites and to become directly involved in politics (i.e. policy-making) for the sake of business interests. The social strategy employed was to strengthen social networks and reinforce the religious social space through the Al-Irsyad Al-Islamiyyah social foundation in Purwokerto. This social strategy strengthens the bond between economic and political forces in perpetuating their business interests while safeguarding ethnic identity.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：本文探讨了Basalamah家族企业如何利用政治和社会策略来巩固财富和权力。

🔬 研究方法：研究采用了定性方法和案例研究方法，通过观察、深度访谈和文档收集数据。

📊 核心发现：研究发现，该家族通过建立与地方政治精英的恩庇网络、在地区议会担任战略职位，以及通过宗教基金会加强社会网络，成功巩固了其商业利益。

💡 应用价值：该研究补充了政治经济学文献，揭示了经济、政治和宗教身份力量在地方商业和政治中的影响。

papers.title: Flux-Corrected Diagonal Frog: second order and positivity at all time steps
papers.abstract: By Godunov's theorem, linear second-order finite-difference schemes for the Fokker-Planck equation cannot preserve positivity. The Diagonal Frog (DF) framework previously bypassed this barrier using eventual positivity, but required a strict minimum time step. This paper resolves the small-step limitation using a nonlinear extension of the DF solvers. We split the second-order directional operator into a monotone M-matrix core and an antidiffusive flux correction. A Zalesak-type limiter is then applied iteratively within the implicit banded solve. The resulting Flux-Corrected DF (FCDF) schemes (variants A and B) are unconditionally positive across all time steps. Because the limiter acts on fluxes rather than point values, these schemes conserve discrete mass exactly and maintain second-order accuracy. Crucially, the limiter activates only within unresolved layers. This ensures the global $L_1$ convergence remains second-order uniformly in the cell Péclet number, avoiding the first-order degradation seen in the Chang-Cooper scheme. The method's Picard iteration is contractive under a purely convective step restriction. To support arbitrary step sizes, we develop an active-set reformulation. This solves the system using a semismooth Newton iteration, where computational cost scales only with the number of nodes where positivity binds. Finally, we introduce a defect-corrected time stepping approach that restores second-order time accuracy. Numerical experiments on Ornstein-Uhlenbeck and advection-dominated benchmarks confirm our claims.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】根据Godunov定理，用于Fokker-Planck方程的线性二阶有限差分格式无法保持数值解的正性。Diagonal Frog（DF）框架之前通过引入“最终正性”机制规避了这一限制，但需要使用严格的最小时间步长。本文通过扩展DF求解器的非线性功能，解决了小时间步长的问题。我们将二阶方向算子分解为一个单调的M矩阵核心和一个抗扩散通量校正项，并在隐式带状求解过程中迭代应用Zalesak型限流器。由此得到的Flux-Corrected DF（FCDF）格式（变体A和B）在所有时间步长下均能保持数值解的正性。由于限流器作用于通量而非节点值，这些格式能够精确保持离散质量并维持二阶精度。关键在于，限流器仅在未求解的层中起作用，从而确保全局$L_1$收敛性在单元Péclet数范围内始终保持二阶一致性，避免了Chang-Cooper格式中出现的一阶精度下降现象。该方法在纯对流步骤限制下具有收敛性。为支持任意时间步长，我们提出了基于活动集的重构算法，该算法采用半光滑牛顿迭代法进行求解，计算成本仅与存在正性约束的节点数量成正比。最后，我们引入了一种缺陷校正时间步进方法，以恢复二阶时间精度。通过对O...。研究方法：实验方法。

papers.title: Licensing and Innovation Regimes in Pharmaceutical R&D
papers.abstract: We study how licensing affects the allocation of innovation in pharmaceutical R&D. We develop a model in which projects differ in both quality and innovation regime, distinguishing between incremental and novel innovations. Information precision is higher for incremental projects and lower for novel ones, generating different equilibrium dynamics in the market for technology. The model predicts that licensing sustains positive selection and competitive return equalization for incremental innovation, while novel projects may exhibit weaker screening consistent with lemons-type frictions. Using product-level data and Double Machine Learning methods, we test these predictions across success probabilities and monetary returns. We find that licensing increases success probability overall, but return equalization holds primarily for incremental projects. For novel innovation, licensing does not exhibit the same equilibrium adjustment, suggesting residual market imperfections. Instrumenting for licensing using exogenous pipeline shocks confirms this pattern causally: the competitive risk-return trade-off is preserved for incremental 'rushed' licenses, but it breaks down for novel ones. Our results reconcile evidence on both competitive efficiency and information frictions in markets for technologies, showing that market performance depends systematically on the type of innovation being transacted.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了许可制度如何影响制药研发中的创新分配。我们构建了一个模型，在该模型中，不同项目在创新质量和创新模式上存在差异，区分了渐进式创新和颠覆性创新。渐进式创新的信息准确性较高，而颠覆性创新的信息准确性较低，这导致了技术市场不同的均衡动态。模型预测，许可制度能够促进渐进式创新的正向选择和竞争性收益均衡；而颠覆性创新则可能因“柠檬市场”摩擦效应而表现出较弱的筛选机制。通过使用产品层面的数据以及双重机器学习方法，我们对这些预测进行了验证，考察了不同成功概率和货币回报情况下的结果。研究发现，许可制度总体上提高了项目的成功概率，但收益均衡主要体现在渐进式创新上。对于颠覆性创新而言，许可制度并未带来类似的均衡调整，这表明市场中存在残余的不完善性。通过利用外部研发管线冲击作为许可制度的工具变量，我们进一步证实了这一因果关系：渐进式创新项目的竞争性风险-回报权衡关系得以保持，而颠覆性创新项目的这一关系则被打破。我们的研究结果调和了关于技术市场竞争效率与信息摩擦的相关证据，表明市场表现系统性地取决于所交易的创新类型。。研究方法：机器学习、均衡模型。

papers.title: Untangling the Complexities of Central Bank Digital Currency Rejection Amongst Merchants: A Qualitative Comparative Analytical Approach
papers.abstract: This study draws on behavioural economic theories, particularly dispositional resistance to change and status quo bias, and extends them by incorporating the relatively overlooked concept of perceived economic risks of non‐adoption. Drawing on this integrated framework, it empirically examines the configurations of antecedents that contribute to the rejection of central bank digital currencies (CBDCs). Using fuzzy‐set qualitative comparative analysis (fsQCA), it is the first to examine early CBDC rejection with a specific focus on merchants in a pioneering CBDC country. The findings highlight five distinct conditions influencing CBDC rejection. Crucially, even when merchants perceive high economic risks from non‐adoption and express dissatisfaction with existing fintech solutions, rejection persists if routine‐seeking behaviours, emotional resistance to change, and a short‐term focus are present. These results demonstrate that resistance to innovation often stems from entrenched behavioural and psychological factors, rather than purely rational considerations. By identifying the diverse pathways leading to CBDC rejection, this study offers policymakers critical insights into the complex interplay of resistance factors. It provides a foundation for designing targeted interventions aimed at mitigating merchant resistance and fostering broader adoption of digital currencies.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】本研究基于行为经济理论，尤其是人们对变化的抗拒心理以及现状偏好（status quo bias），并进一步引入了较少被关注的“不采用数字货币所面临的经济风险”这一概念。在这一综合框架下，本研究通过实证分析探讨了导致拒绝央行数字货币（CBDC）的各种前置因素。采用模糊集定性比较分析（fsQCA）方法，该研究首次专门针对一个率先推出CBDC的国家的商家群体，分析了早期拒绝CBDC的行为模式。研究结果揭示了五个主要影响CBDC接受度的因素。关键在于：即便商家意识到不采用CBDC会带来较高的经济风险，并对现有的金融科技解决方案感到不满，但如果他们倾向于遵循常规做法、存在对变化的情绪抗拒，或者过于关注短期利益，拒绝态度依然会持续存在。这些结果表明，对创新的抗拒往往源于根深蒂固的行为和心理因素，而不仅仅是纯粹的理性考量。通过识别导致CBDC被拒绝的多种路径，本研究为政策制定者提供了关于抗拒因素复杂相互作用的重要见解，为设计旨在缓解商家抗拒情绪、促进数字货币更广泛应用的干预措施奠定了基础。。

papers.title: ESG Disclosure and Firm Value: The Moderating Role of Competitive Advantage
papers.venue: Dinasti International Journal of Economics, Finance & Accounting
papers.abstract: Environmental, social, and governance (ESG) disclosure has been increasingly recognized as a significant determinant of firm value; however, its effectiveness is believed to be influenced by the firm's internal conditions, particularly its competitive advantage. This study aims to examine the effect of ESG disclosure on firm value and to investigate the moderating role of competitive advantage in this relationship. The research sample comprises companies listed on the ESG Quality 45 KEHATI Index of the Indonesia Stock Exchange over the period 2021–2024. Moderated regression analysis was employed using EViews software. The results indicate that ESG disclosure positively affects firm value, suggesting that sustainability transparency enhances stakeholder trust and drives higher market valuations. Furthermore, competitive advantage is found to significantly strengthen the positive effect of environmental, ESG disclosure on firm value, indicating that firms with stronger competitive positions are better able to leverage their sustainability disclosure in creating value for stakeholders. These findings enrich the application of stakeholder theory by establishing that competitive advantage serves as a critical boundary condition that determines the effectiveness of environmental, social, and governance disclosure in enhancing firm value.
papers.summary_zh: 【公司金融】环境、社会和治理（ESG）信息披露日益被视为企业价值的重要决定因素；然而，其有效性被认为受到企业内部条件的制约，尤其是企业的竞争优势。本研究旨在探讨ESG信息披露对企业价值的影响，并分析竞争优势在这一关系中的调节作用。研究样本涵盖了2021年至2024年间在印度尼西亚证券交易所ESG Quality 45 KEHATI指数中上市的公司。研究采用了EViews软件进行调节回归分析。结果表明，ESG信息披露对企业价值具有积极影响，说明可持续性透明度能够增强利益相关者的信任并推动更高的市场估值。此外，研究发现竞争优势显著增强了环境、社会和治理信息披露对企业价值的正面效应，表明具有较强竞争优势的企业能够更有效地利用其可持续性信息披露为利益相关者创造价值。这些发现丰富了利益相关者理论的应用，表明竞争优势是决定环境、社会和治理信息披露在提升企业价值方面有效性的关键因素。。研究方法：回归分析。

papers.title: The The Impact of Sustainable Development on Financial Performance with The Role of Artificial Neural Networks as A Moderate Variable in Iraq
papers.abstract: In this paper, we analyzed the relationship between sustainable development practices and the financial performance of Iraqi industrial companies and investigated the moderating effect of artificial neural networks. Given the significance of sustainability as a worldwide issue, this study seeks to fill the research gap regarding sustainability in developing economies. Different metrics for sustainability and financial performance are evaluated through analysis of empirical data of Iraqi industrial organizations. This study uses artificial neural networks to assess their contribution to improving these interactions. It finds that sustainability activities lead to better financial performance, so the focus on environmental, social and governance (ESG) issues does indeed matter. Moreover, artificial neural networks significantly improve the accuracy of the prediction of financial performance using sustainability criteria. Corporations that employ sustainable practices and advanced computational techniques also obtain superior financial results through those applications. This publication contributes to the theoretical discourse on sustainability, financial performance, and artificial intelligence by developing action-oriented suggestions for industry leaders in Iraq. It also directs the next phase of research and policy development for sustainable industrial advancement.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】本文分析了可持续发展实践与伊拉克工业公司财务绩效之间的关系，并探讨了人工神经网络的调节作用。鉴于可持续性作为全球性问题的重要性，本研究旨在填补关于发展中国家可持续性研究的空白。通过分析伊拉克工业组织的实证数据，本文评估了多种可持续性和财务绩效的衡量指标。研究利用人工神经网络来评估这些因素对提升财务绩效的贡献，发现可持续发展活动能够改善公司的财务表现，因此关注环境、社会和治理（ESG）问题确实具有重要意义。此外，人工神经网络显著提高了基于可持续性指标预测财务绩效的准确性。采用可持续发展实践和先进计算技术的公司也因此获得了更优异的财务成果。该研究为伊拉克的产业领导者提供了具有实践指导意义的建议，丰富了关于可持续性、财务绩效和人工智能的理论探讨，并为可持续工业发展的后续研究与政策制定提供了方向。。研究方法：神经网络。

papers.title: Resilience Factors of Entrepreneurship Amid Economic Crisis: Evidence from Lebanon
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  This study examines how key resilience factors are associated with the ability of Lebanese SMEs and entrepreneurs to withstand and adapt during Lebanon’s severe economic crisis. Using survey data from 66 companies, we analyze the relationships between strategies, support, and ecosystem actors amid prolonged instability. Our analysis reveals that proactive strategic orientations and targeted ecosystem support are positively associated with the resilience of businesses. In addition, the study identifies the main forms and sources of external assistance associated with the survival and growth of SMEs in a context of institutional fragility. By situating these findings within existing frameworks, our paper provides empirical insights relevant to research on SME resilience, strategic orientation, and entrepreneurial ecosystems. This study contributes to the understanding of entrepreneurial responses to multiple shocks in emerging markets and offers avenues for policy interventions aimed at supporting the resilience of SMEs in a context of extreme uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
【资产定价】摘要  
本研究探讨了关键韧性因素如何影响黎巴嫩中小企业及企业家在严峻经济危机中的抵御能力和适应能力。通过分析66家企业的调查数据，我们研究了在长期不稳定环境下企业战略、支持体系及生态系统参与者之间的关系。研究发现，积极主动的战略导向和有针对性的生态系统支持对企业的韧性具有积极促进作用。此外，研究还明确了在制度脆弱背景下，中小企业生存与增长所依赖的主要外部援助形式与来源。将这些发现置于现有理论框架之中，本文为中小企业韧性、战略导向及创业生态系统相关研究提供了实证依据。本研究有助于理解新兴市场中企业家对多重冲击的应对策略，并为制定旨在支持中小企业在极端不确定环境下保持韧性的政策干预措施提供了思路。。研究方法：调查数据。

papers.title: PARADIGM SHIFT IN FINTECH DEVELOPMENT IN THE AGE OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE: FROM TOOL EMPOWERMENT TO ECOLOGICAL RECONSTRUCTION
papers.venue: Journal of trends in financial and economics.
papers.abstract: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, particularly the breakthroughs in large language models and AI agents, is driving a fundamental paradigm shift in the fintech sector. This paper proposes a theoretical framework to characterize the transition of fintech from a "tool empowerment" phase, where technology serves as an efficiency-enhancing instrument within existing financial structures, to an "ecological reconstruction" phase, where AI agents, embedded finance, and decentralized technologies fundamentally reshape the organizational forms, value creation mechanisms, and competitive dynamics of the financial industry. We develop a three-dimensional analytical framework encompassing technological architecture, institutional logic, and value network to systematically examine this transformation. Through a mixed-methods approach combining comparative case studies of 12 representative financial institutions and quantitative analysis of patent data from 2015 to 2025, we find that: (1) the paradigm shift follows a non-linear S-curve trajectory, with a critical inflection point occurring around 2023-2024; (2) AI agent-driven autonomous workflows can reduce operational costs by 35-48% while improving risk assessment accuracy by 22-31%; (3) the ecological reconstruction phase exhibits distinct network effects where platform-based financial ecosystems achieve 2.3-3.7 times higher customer lifetime value compared to traditional linear models; (4) the transition presents significant regulatory challenges, particularly regarding algorithmic accountability, data sovereignty, and systemic risk aggregation in interconnected AI-financial networks. Our findings contribute to the theoretical understanding of technology-induced institutional change in financial systems and offer practical implications for financial institutions, technology firms, and policymakers navigating this transformative period.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融科技】人工智能的快速发展，尤其是大型语言模型和人工智能代理方面的突破，正在推动金融科技领域发生根本性的范式转变。本文提出了一个理论框架，用以描述金融科技从“工具赋能”阶段向“生态重构”阶段的转变过程。在“工具赋能”阶段，技术主要作为现有金融结构中的效率提升工具；而在“生态重构”阶段，人工智能代理、嵌入式金融系统以及去中心化技术将彻底重塑金融行业的组织形态、价值创造机制和竞争格局。我们构建了一个三维分析框架，涵盖技术架构、制度逻辑和价值网络三个维度，以系统地研究这一转型过程。通过结合12家代表性金融机构的案例研究以及2015至2025年间的专利数据进行的定量分析，我们发现：（1）这一范式转变遵循非线性的S型曲线轨迹，关键转折点出现在2023至2024年左右；（2）由人工智能代理驱动的自动化工作流程能够将运营成本降低35%至48%，同时将风险评估的准确性提高22%至31%；（3）在“生态重构”阶段，基于平台的金融生态系统能够实现比传统线性模型高2.3至3.7倍的客户生命周期价值；（4）这一转型过程带来了重大的监管挑战，尤其是在算法责任、数据主权以及互联的AI-金融网络中的系统性风险聚集方面...。研究方法：大语言模型。

papers.title: Model Risk via Signature-Induced Optimal Transport
papers.abstract: We propose a signature-induced, optimal transport framework for path-space model risk, in which ambiguity between stochastic path laws is factorized through optimal transport costs on signature coordinates under a common coupling. Via an ambient feature-space relaxation, we derive for affine signature scores and affine half-space events explicit robust expectation and probability bounds that depend only on the baseline model. In both cases, the correction is governed by the same effective budget, which depends only on the affine score and the budget vector of the ambiguity set. Moreover, the same quantity leads to a budget-aware sparse signature surrogate method for more general, possibly implicit, or data-driven, path functionals. We illustrate the resulting methodology through controlled stress tests and benchmark model-misspecification problems in finance and insurance.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】我们提出了一种基于签名特征的最优传输框架，用于处理路径空间模型中的风险问题。在该框架中，随机路径法则之间的不确定性通过共同耦合下的签名坐标上的最优传输成本来消除。通过引入环境特征空间的松弛机制，我们为仿射签名得分和仿射半空间事件推导出了明确的鲁棒期望值和概率界限，这些界限仅依赖于基线模型。在这两种情况下，修正过程都受到相同有效预算的约束，该预算仅取决于仿射得分以及不确定性集的预算向量。此外，同一数学量还可以用于构建一种考虑预算约束的稀疏签名替代方法，以适用于更一般的情况，包括隐式模型或数据驱动的路径函数。我们通过金融和保险领域的受控压力测试及模型误设问题，验证了所提出方法的有效性。。研究方法：随机过程。

papers.title: Quantum Kernels and the Cross-Section of Stock Returns: Anatomy of a Vanishing Advantage
papers.abstract: Do quantum kernels improve cross-sectional stock return prediction? We run a controlled horse race on the Chinese A-share market in which a quantum fidelity kernel, a projected quantum kernel, and a classical RBF control share identical training subsamples, solver, and tuning budgets, so that only the kernel is exchanged. On the main evaluation -- a point-in-time universe and 170 walk-forward windows (2012-2025) -- no quantum advantage exists: the fidelity kernel is indistinguishable from its RBF control ($Δ$IC $=+0.005$, $p=0.42$), and a $2\times2$ design crossing kernel type with training budget (a Nystrom extension to the full ~38,000-observation windows) shows quantum kernels matching, but never beating, equal-budget linear models; after family-wise correction no pairwise difference among eleven models is significant, with point estimates favoring penalized linear regressions throughout. We then document how the opposite conclusion arises: a 60-window evaluation on a universe screened with full-sample information makes the same quantum kernel appear dominant on stability criteria and significantly better than neural baselines. Interaction characteristics from the anomalies literature help nothing, quantum or classical; a widened bandwidth grid reveals an interior optimum rather than the near-classical endpoint a coarse grid suggests; and the geometric difference, while large throughout ($g \gg 1$), does not predict out-of-sample gains ($ρ=-0.20$). We propose protocol standards -- kernel-swap controls, budget-equalized comparisons, point-in-time universes, and multiplicity-robust inference -- for empirical claims of quantum advantage in finance.
papers.summary_zh:
【资产定价】量子核是否能够提升股票回报的预测能力？我们在中国A股市场进行了一项对照实验，实验中使用了量子保真度核（quantum fidelity kernel）、预测型量子核（projected quantum kernel）以及传统的RBF核（classical RBF kernel）。所有模型都使用了相同的训练数据子集、求解器和调整预算，唯一的区别在于所使用的核函数类型。在主要评估指标——即2012年至2025年期间的170个滚动时间窗口（point-in-time windows）——中，我们并未观察到量子核的任何优势：量子保真度核与其对应的RBF核在预测性能上没有显著差异（ΔIC = +0.005，p = 0.42）。即使将训练预算扩大到覆盖全部约38,000个观测值的范围内，使用2×2设计的交叉核（2×2 design crossing kernel），量子核的预测效果也与线性模型相当，甚至无法超越线性模型；经过家族间差异校正后，这十一个模型之间没有统计学上的显著差异，所有点的估计结果均显示惩罚线性回归（penalized linear regressions）的表现更优。

然...。研究方法：横截面分析、回归分析。

papers.title: Identifying Treatment and Spillover Effects with Control-Based and Forecast-Based Counterfactuals
papers.abstract: Spillovers and interference pose fundamental challenges for causal inference, as treatment assigned to one unit may affect the outcome of others, violating the no-interference assumption underlying most empirical strategies. Existing approaches, based on partial interference, exposure mapping, spatial, network, or structural frameworks, typically rely on strong assumptions about interaction structures or require the existence of uncontaminated control units to estimate relevant causal parameters. We revisit this identification challenge within the potential outcomes framework and compare the conditions under which causal effects can be identified using two broad classes of counterfactual methods: control-based counterfactual methods (CBCMs), such as matching and difference-in-differences designs, and forecast-based counterfactual methods (FBCMs), including interrupted time-series and machine learning control methods. We show under which circumstances CBCMs and FBCMs identify average direct and spillover effects. Through simulations and an empirical application, we illustrate the main advantages and limitations of each approach. We show that, in the presence of pervasive or ill-defined spillover effects, CBCMs either cannot be used or entail severe identification concerns, whereas FBCMs can more credibly identify some of the causal parameters of interest, at least in the short term.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】溢出效应和干扰现象对因果推断构成了根本性挑战，因为对某一单元实施的干预措施可能会影响其他单元的结果，从而违背了大多数实证研究方法所基于的“无干扰”假设。现有的研究方法主要基于部分干扰效应、暴露关系映射、空间结构、网络结构或结构框架，这些方法通常需要对交互作用机制有较强的假设，或者需要存在未受干扰的对照单元才能估计出相关的因果参数。我们在潜在结果（potential outcomes）框架下重新审视了这一识别难题，并比较了使用两类广泛的反事实方法（counterfactual methods）来识别因果效应的条件：基于控制的反事实方法（Control-Based Counterfactual Methods, CBCMs），如匹配（matching）和差异-in-differences设计；以及基于预测的反事实方法（Forecast-Based Counterfactual Methods, FBCMs），包括中断时间序列分析（interrupted time-series analysis）和机器学习控制方法（machine learning control methods）。我...。研究方法：双重差分、因果推断、数值模拟、机器学习。
